The memory bank indicates the root cause has already been identified: **double-destruction bug** in main.cpp. The CustomHeapManager destructor is called twice:
1. Explicitly at line 177 in shutdown()
2. Again at line 186 in ~Application() destructor which calls shutdown()

This causes a double-free of the heap_memory pointer. The crash only manifests in release mode due to optimization differences.

The recorded fix strategy was to prevent this double-destruction from user.cpp since main.cpp cannot be modified - either through guard logic or lifecycle intervention to prevent the second destructor call from executing on already-freed memory.

Your current plan to initialize stdlib features in user_init() addresses a different theory (static objects from custom heap) but doesn't address the identified double-destruction issue. Consider whether the double-destruction explanation better fits the observed behavior (crash after completion, only in release mode).
</context_for_action>
